summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl.py with parametrized valid and invalid cases plus a non-node input test. The test_extras and test_path.py suites pass (118 passed, 2 skipped, 3 xfailed). Nothing is committed. mypy, black, and isort are not installed in the shared venv, so type-ignore placement and line lengths were checked by reading the code and with awk. The non-node check uses a small bool helper so warn_unreachable does not flag it, and the argument-type ignores sit on the parser call lines inside the pytest.raises blocks.
